title: Dashboard for Swachhta and LiFE. Develop a dashboard aimed at maintaining cleanliness and LiFE practices, integrating AI-powered image processing technology for effective monitoring of Swachhta and green practices adopted in post offices. The dashboard needs to be accessible from the Divisional Office offering surveillance capabilities and triggering alerts for deviation from prescribed Swachhta and Green Growth standards to prompt on ground intervention to guide the post office concerned to make necessary changes to conform to set expectations.
